name: @saasreport/broker
description: The agent credential broker for Workers: agents hold no GitHub credential; a signed, fresh, single-use request from a registered agent (kit agent id, Ed25519 key) gets a short-lived installation token scoped to one repository and the action's permissions, and a merge happens only through the broker after green checks on the exact head and a signed review by a different agent. Every allow and deny is a hash-chained evidence record.
